body: Integrated API + animal-health formulation platform (Alivira: Europe, Turkey, Brazil, India; BioForLife Italy from Oct-2026) + 60%-owned Appco Pharma (US generics). Merger with Viyash Life Sciences and Symed effective 16-Dec-2025 (common control, appointed 1-Apr-2025); name change 9-Jan-2026. Promoter Carlyle (CA Hull) 49.24% at Sep-2026; MD/Group CEO Dr Haribabu Bodepudi (2.03 cr warrants at Rs 181.94). TTM revenue Rs 3,713 cr; net debt Rs 26 cr (Sep-2026); ICRA AA-/Stable. Auditor S R B C & Co LLP. Live deep dive #9 (2026-11-26).
title: Viyash Scientific Ltd (NSE: VIYASH; BSE 512529; formerly SeQuent Scientific)
